raw_block.rationale: Targets the airline trigger with the retained position-based reasoning skeleton, while using individually readable checked-position fees and aligned excess-fee bands that were successfully extracted on the closely matched history case.

inputs.question: What is the current passenger's integer ticket price?

inputs.name: lengths
inputs.question: What are the outside lengths in inches of the current passenger's items, in stated order?

inputs.name: widths

inputs.question: What are the outside heights in inches of the current passenger's items, in stated order?

inputs.name: weights

inputs.name: carryon_limits
inputs.question: What ordered length, width, and height limits apply to one carry-on bag under the current source?

inputs.name: first_checked_fee
inputs.question: For the current itinerary and cabin, what is the numeric base fee for the first checked bag?

inputs.name: second_checked_fee

inputs.name: third_checked_fee

inputs.name: weight_limits_by_checked_position
inputs.question: For each resulting checked-bag position, what standard weight limit applies after accounting for the current cabin and any complimentary status?

inputs.name: overweight_upper_bounds
inputs.question: What ascending weight upper bounds cover the standard and applicable overweight bands for the current route, including the standard band?

inputs.name: overweight_fees
inputs.question: What numeric fees align with the current route's weight bands, including zero for the standard band?

inputs.name: size_upper_bounds

inputs.name: size_fees

skill.intent: Compute the exact ticket-plus-bag-fee total by classifying cabin items, assigning checked-bag position fees, and applying the higher applicable overweight or oversize fee to each checked bag.

outputs.description: The exact current ticket price plus all applicable checked-bag, overweight, and oversize fees.
outputs.name: answer

reads.question: Jointly read the current passenger's ordered item measurements and ticket price and the applicable cabin-item limits, checked-position fees, position-specific weight allowances, and route-specific excess-fee bands.
reads.source_locator: current facts, question, and baggage-fee source

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Use at most one qualifying personal-item allowance and one qualifying carry-on allowance; treat remaining items as checked bags.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Determine each checked bag's size by summing its three outside dimensions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag exceeds both weight and size standards, add only the higher excess fee to its checked-position fee.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
